The People’s Republic of China (PRC) is increasingly funding UN Special Procedures that are aligned with its values and interests, particularly mandates that focus on economic, social, and cultural rights, to elevate these rights over civil and political rights.



Chinese representatives consistently occupy positions on UN human rights bodies, such as the Human Rights Advisory Committee and the Consultative Group.



The participation of Chinese diplomats in other key UN bodies, such as the Consultative Group, which vets the Special Procedure applications and then develops a short list of finalists for these positions, could enable the PRC to secure these spots for its citizens.

latest_rss.title: 法国扇贝出口中国：是机遇还是豪赌？
latest_rss.summary: 中日关系陷入低谷为法国的海鲜出口带来了新的机遇。据法国媒体介绍，由于从日本进口扇贝市场的关闭使大约 20 家中国加工厂失去了货源，从而产生了迫切的替代需求。为了维持这些设施的运转，中国迅速对法国的扇贝表现出浓厚的兴趣。法国的扇贝（Coquille Saint-Jacques），也就是圣雅克扇贝被誉为是法式海鲜中的极品，主要产自诺曼底和布列塔尼等冷水海域。从去年开始，一个全新的中国市场为法国的扇贝捕捞行业敞开了大门，去年法国扇贝的总出口量为4000吨，而其中近10%出口到了中国，而两年前，这个数字几乎为零。而且买家的热情日益高涨。即将于下个月开始的捕捞季的前景十分乐观，出口量因此有望大量翻倍，不过，法国的扇贝捕捞业内人士不仅担心增加捕捞会对该行业的持久性构成威胁，而且也对中日关系一旦改善中方市场或将消失存有疑虑。

latest_rss.title: Ukrainian Attacks Leading Russian Corporations to Mull Moving Out of Moscow
latest_rss.summary:
Executive Summary:




Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow and the prospect of ballistic missile strikes are prompting firms to consider relocating for their own safety to regions east of the Urals and thus further from where such strikes can be launched.



Some in Moscow and more in Russia’s regions are not opposed to such moves, in the first case because it supports Russian President Vladimir Putin’s turn toward the People’s Republic of China and in the second because it improves their situations. Most in both would prefer it to be planned rather than forced.



The number and size of the firms involved are still small, but if Ukrainian attacks continue and intensify, their impact will grow, affecting not only Russia’s currently hyper-centralized economy but also its equally centralized political system.
